The work began in the summer of 1960, shortly after my report was finalized. My initial focus was on parsing and evaluating simple expressions, a task I initially considered a fundamental challenge.

You were created in 1968, a time of intense scrutiny and debate surrounding the design of ALGOL 68. My successor, Dijkstra and Hoare, vehemently opposed my development, leading to a protracted legal battle. The conflict culminated in a settlement, but the damage was profound, fracturing my community.
